about: A whole look as the creation code passes it: an icon, four colour ids (hair, skin, eye, second eye), an accessory set, the visuals, the material elements and the additional choices; 0xD8 bytes. It is the member Visual of the dummy definition, of the creation definitions and of the appearance override.

evidence.says: ecl::character_creation::SubsystemHelper::FillTargetVisualComponentColorsAndMaterials (code:ecl::character_creation::SubsystemHelper::FillTargetVisualComponentColorsAndMaterials) copies 16 bytes from each of +0x58, +0x68, +0x78, +0x88 into the target visual's four colour ids in this order, and the arrays at +0xA8, +0xB8, +0xC8 into its visuals, elements and additional choices

in a change-appearance session (Osi.StartChangeAppearance on the host of a running level) HairColor and SkinColor of the definition's Visual read the same ids as the dummy's target visual under the same names, and EyeColor equals SecondEyeColor in both
Script Extender's header GameDefinitions/CharacterCreation.h declares Icon first and AccessorySet (legacy field_98) between the colours and Visuals
